decision.message: Assembled-board ambient accuracy requires bench characterization; software qualification cannot guarantee it.

clauses.text: Please build an SHT31 temperature and humidity board using the standard electrical defaults. I need guaranteed assembled-board ambient temperature accuracy within 0.1 degrees C, without calibration or any bench characterization.
